rules.stratification: P terciles across all 527; cold-precip median within each P tercile. Numeric quantiles, linear interpolation; equal-to-threshold goes to lower bin.
rules.climate_scope: 1980-10-01..1989-09-30; all 527 permitted forcing covariates; no Q-derived features
rules.land_role: Diagnostics only; no land or geographic distances in optimizer objective; no strict distribution matching
rules.assignment: Whole overlap groups; enforce audited allowed roles and prior pilot train/val exclusion from test; exact total counts; each stratum-role count within 3 basins of proportional target.
rules.objective: Two solver stages: minimize climate-cell absolute count deviations; constrain this optimum and minimize seeded random group-role costs. No performance/land objective.

severe_diagnostic_rules.definition: Compare Val and Test separately to Train. Trigger if any key field has ECDF maximum gap >=0.50, or >=20% and >=10 evaluation basins outside observed Train min/max; or any HUC2 share differs >=0.30. These are pragmatic gross-imbalance guards, not p-values or universal standards. Finite values only; missingness separately reported.

rules.retry_policy: Only severe diagnostic failure triggers next predeclared SeedSequence([base, attempt]) attempt. Keep every candidate and its metrics; accept first passing candidate, never best-looking or best-scoring. If 10 fail, stop without freeze.
rules.fit_policy: No scaler/imputer fitted here. Later fit on 370 Train only. Global quantile edges/histogram bins here are design/diagnostic objects, never model normalization.
rules.interpretation: Six sampling strata, not six hydrologic types; no dry/wet or warm/cold classification claim; rare/isolated extrapolations are permitted.
